# Purpzie's Utilities
[![Add to VCC](https://img.shields.io/badge/Add_to-VCC-blue)](https://purpzie.com/vpm)
![No AI][NoAIBadge]

A collection of prefabs, scripts, and tools for VRChat.

- [Face Tracking Templates](./Face%20Tracking%20Templates)
- [Frametime](./Frametime)
- [Poiyomi Presets](./Poiyomi%20Presets)
- [Smooth Remote Scaling](./Smooth%20Remote%20Scaling)
- [Wireframe Overlay](./Wireframe%20Overlay)

## Install
1. [Click here](https://purpzie.com/vpm) to add the VPM repository to the VRChat Creator Companion.
   - If that doesn't work, then in the VCC, go to Settings > Packages > Add Repository, paste [`https://purpzie.com/vpm/index.json`](https://purpzie.com/vpm/index.json) and click Add.
2. Make sure `Purpzie's VCC Packages` is checked.
3. Go back and click `Manage Project` next to your project, then add Purpzie's Utilities.
